mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing overcast skies at 37 degrees near the Verona Public Library with a waning gibbous moon. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. Expect an overnight low of 31 degrees with no rain predicted.

For those interested in local government, the City of Verona has released candidate packets for the 2027 Spring Election. All four Aldermanic District seats will be on the ballot, and candidates must return their paperwork to the City Clerk by 5:00 p.m. on January 5, 2027.

It is a busy few days in town. Today features Yoga at Insight Wellness, ART House 360 Thursday Nights, and Hop Haus Trivia. Looking ahead to tomorrow, enjoy live music at Bailey's Run, the 50th-anniversary celebration at Wisconsin Brewing Company, and the Crafty Fair at ART House 360.
On November 6, the Verona Police Department responded to a report of a driver slumped over in a vehicle in the 500 block of West Verona Avenue, which resulted in an arrest for O W I.
The restaurant is closed for the night, but we look forward to the Snickers Swirl flavor of the day arriving when they open tomorrow at 10:00 AM.
